operation.summary: Delete a folder and its current objects or all versions
operation.description: Requires admin:* management authority. Default deletion uses S3 versioning semantics and preserves historical versions in enabled buckets. all_versions=true permanently deletes every historical version and delete marker under the exact slash-terminated prefix. Legal Hold and retention are enforced. A concurrent write may return 409; partial progress is possible and retries are supported even after the folder record is removed. Physical orphan data is reclaimed by GC.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Slash-terminated folder key; empty and root prefixes are rejected.

operation.summary: Force cleanup folder
operation.description: Requires admin:* management authority. Repairs stale directory index entries against authoritative metadata and runs the shared reachability-based garbage collector. Removes index entries whose persistent record is absent or tombstoned; restores missing or outdated index state for valid directory records. Healthy empty folders, current objects, historical versions, delete markers, and active multipart uploads are preserved. This is not recursive deletion. Unreadable or corrupt authoritative metadata requires recovery and is never discarded on the assumption that it is garbage. Repairs may partially complete before an error; retries are supported. Shared GC can also reclaim unreferenced data elsewhere while preserving all reachable data.

key.description: Slash-terminated folder key; root is forbidden

204.description: Directory reconciliation and orphan-data collection completed

409.description: Concurrent changes or remaining live content

503.description: Repair incomplete or corrupt metadata requires recovery

operation.summary: Describe, rotate, schedule deletion, restore, or permanently delete a key
operation.description: Requires running KMS and the matching policy action on arn:aws:kms:::key/{id}. Describe uses kms:DescribeKey, rotation uses kms:RotateKey, and deletion lifecycle operations use kms:DeleteKey. Conditions and explicit Deny apply. Immediate deletion supports enabled and pending-deletion keys. Deleting or scheduling deletion of the last key is rejected with HTTP 409 (KmsLastKeyDeletionForbidden). Pending state is enforced by ZigFS; the seven-day date does not trigger automatic deletion.

200.description: Describe returns KMSKey metadata without key material; mutations return {ok: true}.

operation.summary: Read the bounded object event feed with a resumable cursor
operation.description: Requires management authority. Events come from the post-success object event sink, independent of audit logs and notification subscriptions. Omit cursor to start at the current tail. Cursor expiry, process restart or capture failure returns 409; clients must explicitly accept a gap before restarting. Wait is bounded by bearer expiry. Retention is at most 4096 events or 8 MiB across the process. This is not durable or exactly-once delivery. Order is capture order, not storage commit order.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Comma-separated PUT, GET, DELETE, ILM, SCANNER categories
